content: {"reasoning":"The first submission occurred 7 days after service, within the payer’s 90-day filing limit, so the CO-29 denial warrants an appeal supported by the original submission history and corrected COB information. The appeal should also document medical necessity for monitoring the listed rhythm disorder and symptoms; another routine resubmission would not address the filing dispute. The administrative denial does not establish patient liability, so billing the patient or writing off the balance is premature.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
